concept.hr: Projekcije okretne kazaljke: vodoravno I (kosinus), okomito Q (sinus)
concept.en: A turning phasor's projections: I horizontally (a cosine), Q vertically (a sine)

summary.hr: Kazaljka duljine A pod kutom φ daje pri t = 0 I = A · cos φ i Q = A · sin φ; dok se okreće, njezine projekcije crtaju kosinus i sinus pomaknute za 90°.
summary.en: A phasor of length A at angle φ gives I = A · cos φ and Q = A · sin φ at t = 0; as it turns, its projections trace a cosine and a sine 90° apart.

what.hr: Aplet applet_iq_zeiger.html (kazaljka sa sinusnom i kosinusnom projekcijom) i tekst o I/Q prikazu (50ohm.de, odjeljak iq_verfahren)
what.en: The applet applet_iq_zeiger.html (the phasor with its sine and cosine projections) and the text on the I/Q representation (50ohm.de, section iq_verfahren)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu i nacrtan kao SVG umjesto na platnu, preveden na engleski, okretanje u 12 koraka od 30°, dodani udjeli I i Q na osima, početni položaj, očitanja i predlošci
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit and drawn as SVG instead of on a canvas, translated into English, the turn in 12 steps of 30°, the I and Q parts on the axes, the start position, the readout and presets added
